title: The People Who Dance in Pairs

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: After a festival dance in a big circle, a villager wonders whether distant people might dance in pairs instead.

setup.text: After a festival dance in a big circle, (name1) wonders whether distant people might dance in pairs instead.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A shy villager prefers the circle and says so.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A teenager imagines dancing alone, free to move however they like.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: An elder says dancing alone can be just as joyful as dancing together.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village tries a dance with circles, pairs and solos, and it becomes a new favorite.

a1__fx.text: The villagers try it and step on each other's feet, laughing.
